title: Montbello Homecoming Oct 15, 2011
author: madwire
excerpt: It was a packed night at the Montbello Homecoming Dance with JAMMIN’ DJ’s! The theme of the night was a mascarette ball and everyone was having a great time between the casino games and the packed dance floor. The crowd got wilded when the homecoming royalty was announced!
